_about: Links open_link will follow. A link replaces a whole navigation sequence - fewer steps, and on Instagram fewer counted reads.
prefix: the URL must start with this. package: the app it must land in; landing anywhere else is an error, not a success.
count / platform: the ledger read it costs (policy/reads.py). sample: a harmless value used to verify it.
verified: null until `claudephone deeplinks --verify` opened it on a real phone and saw the package come to the front. open_link refuses unverified links.

links.note: opens a profile directly; replaces search + typing + tapping a result
opens a public channel or group by handle, joined or not
the app-native form of a t.me handle link; public usernames only
